summary: An OpenAI researcher tweets that GPT-5.6 now solves 'famous frontier math/stat questions' and one-shots a perfect IMO score, contrasting this with the trajectory of LLM math ability since 2023.

mechanisms.reason: The post claims a named model (GPT-5.6) now one-shots a perfect score on frontier math problems including the IMO, a step beyond prior gold-medal performance, though it is an informal first-person account rather than a published result.
mechanisms.quote: Now, GPT-5.6 solves famous frontier math/stat questions. The IMO is today and 5.6 one-shotting a perfect score isn't even news.

practices.reason: A team building on reasoning-heavy math or quantitative tasks would want to verify whether GPT-5.6's claimed frontier-math performance holds for their own use cases before relying on it.
practices.quote: Now, GPT-5.6 solves famous frontier math/stat questions.
